reasoning_chain: Multiple slow edges radiate from frontend to many downstream services including adservice, cartservice, checkoutservice, currencyservice, productcatalogservice, recommendationservice, and shippingservice.
All these downstream services have low p95 latencies themselves, indicating they are not slow processing requests.
Frontend's own p95 latency is very high at 1615.7ms, while its CPU usage is 0.008 cores out of a 0.010 core limit, which is 77% of its CPU limit, indicating CPU throttling and resource exhaustion.

The pod of frontend was recreated 331 seconds ago, but this is not recent enough to explain the current high latency, and the CPU limit was recently reduced from 200m to 10m, which likely caused the resource exhaustion.
No errors are reported on frontend or downstream services, consistent with latency caused by resource exhaustion rather than crashes or failures.
